messages:
maya: quick question — exporting audit lines for routing policy changes. need actor attribution to cover service accounts / cron jobs and policy anchors. thinking about scope filters and sensitive fields. any objections?
sam: we should include both raw_actor_id and resolved_actor_identity. add actor_type (user|service|system) so consumers don't have to guess.
leo: +1. also include resource_path, policy_anchor, and a minimal diff: changed_fields + before_summary + after_summary. full blobs can be stored separately with a reference id.
maya: agree on refs. perf note: full blobs for large policies will balloon exports. prefer diffs by default and option to include full snapshots.
olivia: console UX: per-route "who changed" should surface actor_display_name, actor_type, timestamp, and link to export/job. ensure link is presigned and expires.
sam: API sketch for exports: 
```
GET /api/v1/audit/exports?scope=tenant&since=2025-09-01T00:00:00Z&include_service_accounts=true&format=ndjson
```
returns 202 + job_id; client polls /api/v1/audit/exports/{job_id} -> {status, presigned_url, estimated_size, filter_summary}

leo: telemetry: record export_job_id, bytes_estimated, bytes_transferred, and whether pii_mode=redact/hash/include. tie to billing and quotas.
audit-bot: Notice: export job queued (job_id=exp_20250921_42) by maya. estimated_size=120MB.
maya: PII handling: export endpoint must support modes: include|redact|hash. default = redact. metadata should include pii_mode and redact_rules_version.
olivia: retention & compliance: ad-hoc exports allowed only for events within retention window (<=90 days) otherwise require e-comm compliance flow. UI should show that limitation upfront.
sam: infra/ops: backend query must avoid full table scans. we need tenant+time sharded indices and a query budget. implement rate limits per-org and canary throttles for heavy queries.
leo: also support an SSE streaming endpoint for small windows: clients can subscribe and get NDJSON lines in real-time. good for live forensic workflows.
maya: sounds agreed. i'll draft the API + NDJSON schema and include small sample lines: 
```
{"ts":"2025-09-20T18:12:03Z","action":"update_policy","resource":"/routes/prod/checkout","actor_id":"svc_abc123","actor_resolved":"svc:billing-janitor@infra","actor_type":"service","changed_fields":["rate_limit"],"before_summary":"rate_limit:100","after_summary":"rate_limit:50","diff_ref":"blob_9876"}
```

maya: i'll open a PR with the schema, API, and console mockups. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Deploy scheduled: 2025-10-02 02:00 UTC — exporter lambda will be rolled.
olivia: :eyes:
